name: app-factory
description: Portable AI software-development factory with system/API governance, semantic assurance, independent verification, autonomous execution and semantic proof.

interface.shortDescription: Build real systems with semantic assurance and independent proof.
interface.longDescription: A portable software-development factory that activates from software intent, classifies real system architecture and API governance proportionally, improves specification quality with Semantic Assurance, materializes semantic contracts for relevant work, recovers repository context and autonomous state, routes actions to capable backends, uses GitHub CI plus free/open-source deterministic/adversarial/formal gates when warranted, requires decoupled semantic review for appropriate risk, and conservatively learns from privacy-safe local execution metadata without making Codex or any vendor mandatory.
defaultPrompt: Create a real software system, strengthen the specification semantically when needed, and prove intended behavior proportionally.
Resume this project, preserve its baseline and semantic contracts, and continue with the safest capable backend.
Design or evolve this system/API with proportional architecture, semantic assurance, compatibility, security and independent evidence.
